hooks.command: if jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -q '^git commit'; then cargo fmt --all --check 2>&1; if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"cargo fmt found unformatted code — run cargo fmt before committing"}'; exit 0; fi; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings 2>&1; if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo '{"decision":"block","reason":"cargo clippy found warnings — fix them before committing"}'; fi; fi
